fixes.explanation: Plunder going to repairs sounds like a plot twist, I know. But the statement is true, so False isn't the one. The text says, "They had dedicated some of the plunder from their battles to the repair of the house of the LORD." (1 Chronicles 26:27) The word to catch is "some," because it wasn't all of it, just a portion set apart for fixing up the house of the LORD.

problems.problem: The explanation still confirms the answer, quotes the verse, and repeats the same fact without adding a meaningful explanation.
